name: Winograd Schema Challenge
description: A commonsense reasoning benchmark consisting of sentence pairs with pronoun coreference ambiguity that requires world knowledge to resolve. Each question presents a sentence with a pronoun and asks which entity it refers to, designed to be easy for humans but difficult for machines using statistical shortcuts.
reputation: Classic NLP benchmark proposed by Hector Levesque as a Turing Test alternative; influenced many commonsense reasoning datasets; largely saturated by modern LLMs
notes: One of the earliest commonsense reasoning benchmarks. Largely saturated by large language models. Led to the creation of Winogrande, a larger and harder variant with 44,000 problems.
